messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick check — planning the next 6 ARB slots. Proposal: Tue 10am weekly, keep rotating facilitator. Need volunteers for weeks 1-4 and someone to claim the KV-cache RFC slot (we should do a short primer + focused Q&A). @Jon @Lee can you take a look?

Jon Patel: I can take week 1 (next Tue). happy to kick off with a 5min context brief. :+1:

Lee Chen: I can do week 2. can someone add the RFC to the calendar and paste the TL;DR here?

Samir Singh: week 3 for me. I'll also take notes and capture action items.

Ava Park: I can do week 4, but can we shorten the agenda to keep it under 40m? our ops folks have back-to-back.

Maria Gomez: Yes — shortened template below. If folks agree, I'll lock the cadence and facilitator rotation. Also asking for a 5-min pre-read from the RFC author so we can triage quickly.

Maria Gomez: ```
Agenda (compact)
- 05m: quick status + housekeeping
- 15m: RFC deep dive (author + 5min demo)
- 10m: focused triage / questions
- 05m: decisions & owners

Timebox = 35m
```

Lee Chen: That works. FYI, the RFC has two alternatives for prefix caching + an async write-through; short pre-read would help. I'll paste the RFC link in a sec.

Jon Patel: Also, can we add an explicit fallback policy check to the agenda? last time it came up and we ran out of time.

Maria Gomez: Good call. adding a line: "Verify fallback & rollout plan (2-3m)" inside the triage block.

Ava Park: For facilitator rotation, propose simple round-robin on the calendar event owner so people get the reminder and notes template. anyone object?

Samir Singh: no objections. round-robin + notes owner is fine. I can do the notes template if you want me to draft it.

Maria Gomez: Please do, Samir. Keep it lightweight: decisions, follow-ups, owners, eta. I'll create the calendar series after we have volunteers for the first 4 weeks.

Lee Chen: RFC link: https://rwx.internal/rfcs/kv-cache-opt. Pre-read: brief section 'tradeoffs' + 3 benchmark graphs. Author is @Ava Park (she's driving this).

Ava Park: Yep — I'll publish a 1-pager and 2 slides by EOD today. Also adding a short compatibility matrix for model variants.

Jon Patel: small ask — can we add a code snippet/tip for measuring tail latency with new cache? last sprint we lost time reproducing env. something like: `wrk -t4 -c200 -d30s --latency` + headers to pin shard.

Ava Park: Good idea, will include a reproducible snippet in the pre-read.

devops-bot: Calendar event created: "ARB - KV-cache RFC (compact)" Tue, next week 10:00-10:35. Organizer: Maria Gomez. Series: weekly (rotating).

Maria Gomez: Perfect. Final checklist: volunteers for week 5+ (we'll keep sign-ups open in this thread), Samir to draft notes template, Ava to publish pre-read, Jon to prep 5m context + tail-lat snippet. I'll post the final agenda in #eng-platform tomorrow. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
